rows.label: qst630202_msg0001
rows.name:
I came all the way to Avaritia, but
there aren't any good hats at all.

rows.label: qst630202_msg0002
rows.name:
Even when I talk to the clerks, all
they recommend are mushroom hats.
Their taste is awful...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0003
rows.name: And you are...?

rows.label: qst630202_msg0004
rows.name: I think I could get along with you.

rows.label: qst630202_msg0005
rows.name:
I came to the Avaritia Trading Company
looking for a stylish hat.

rows.label: qst630202_msg0006
rows.name: But I'm having no luck at all...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0007
rows.name:
I don't care if that weird wannabe
poet of an old man is worried.

rows.label: qst630202_msg0008
rows.name:
I'm not going back to Invidia until I
find a hat.

rows.label: qst630202_msg0009
rows.name:
If only there were someone who could
make me a stylish hat...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0101
rows.name: I have nothing to talk to you about...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0102
rows.name: Our tastes don't seem to match.

rows.label: qst630202_msg0201
rows.name: Um...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0202
rows.name: A hat that would match this outfit...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0203
rows.name: Something simple, but graceful...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0204
rows.name:
I'd like a hat with expensive-looking
ornamentation and a luxurious feel.

rows.label: qst630202_msg0301
rows.name:
So that hatter can make
me one exactly to order?

rows.label: qst630202_msg0302
rows.name:
Why didn't that Nopon say so
sooner...? Honestly...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0303
rows.name:
It doesn't seem like he'd make one if
I went, so could you ask him for me?

rows.label: qst630202_msg0304
rows.name: What I'm looking for right now, is...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0305
rows.name:
A hat that would match
this outfit... Something
simple, but graceful...

rows.label: qst630202_msg0306
rows.name:
A hat with expensive-looking
ornamentation and a luxurious feel.

rows.label: qst630202_msg0307
rows.name: I'm counting on you!
